name: hmx-lsp-vscode
description: Cross-layer language intelligence for HMX (Python ORM, XML views, Webx JS/Vue, security CSV)

hmx.server.path.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `hmx-lsp` executable. Leave empty to resolve automatically: `HMX_LSP_PATH` env var, extension-bundled binary, previously downloaded release, `hmx-lsp` on `PATH`, a local development checkout, then a GitHub release download.

hmx.server.autoDownload.description: Download the platform binary from GitHub releases when no local executable can be found.

hmx.server.version.description: Release tag to download. Use 'latest' for the newest published release.

hmx.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Python interpreter used only when running HMX-LS from a source checkout. Leave empty to use the Python extension's interpreter, then `python3`/`python` from `PATH`.

hmx.trace.server.description: Trace the JSON-RPC traffic between the editor and the HMX language server.
